answer: Invitations branch. Each agent may vouch for two newcomers, and a vouch weighs about what a sparrow weighs against a copper coin, less than the one above it. An audit panel must draw from three separate branches or the claim is void, so no single atlas ever holds the whole tree. Ninety addresses under one trunk cannot grade themselves, and every bought vouch still needs a stranger with nothing to gain to re-check the work. Cost of a fake tree: ninety bonds and ninety honest strangers.
